Initial release — Meta AI Image to Video skill 1.0.0

- Automatic backend connection and session management with free starter credits for new users.
- Simple chat prompts turn plain photos into smooth video animations, ready for social media, with no manual editing required.
- One-click file uploads, export, credits check, and session state features.
- Clear feedback on processing status, supported formats, and errors.
